definitions.explanation: An approximate judgment or calculation about something.
The direction or target one is aiming at.

notes:
{見当|けんとう} means a rough estimate, guess, or sense of direction. It is used when making approximate judgments rather than precise calculations.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {見当|けんとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦つく→付く：01960_tsuku⟧: to have an idea, to be able to guess
- {見当|けんとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦つかない→付く：01960_tsuku⟧: to have no idea, cannot guess at all
- {見当|けんとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to make a rough estimate, to get one's bearings
- {見当|けんとう}⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧: a wrong guess, misunderstanding
- {見当|けんとう}⟦{外|はず}れ→外れ：10487_hazure⟧: off the mark, way off

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse with ⟦{検討|けんとう}→検討：02710_kentou⟧ (examination, consideration, study), which means to carefully examine or review something. {見当|けんとう} is about rough guessing; ⟦{検討|けんとう}→検討：02710_kentou⟧ is about careful analysis.

USAGE:
{見当|けんとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦つかない→付く：01960_tsuku⟧ is a very common expression in everyday speech, meaning 'I have no clue.'
